brief:
Israeli forces demolished a three-story residential building in an area south of Bethlehem, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operation targeted the structure in the southern region of the West Bank city, though specific details about the demolition remained unclear.

The circumstances surrounding the action were not immediately disclosed. Israeli authorities have not provided information regarding the stated reason for the demolition, the timeline of the operation, or the number of residents who occupied the building at the time of its destruction.
title: Israeli military demolishes three-story home south of Bethlehem
